name: Kayseri
registryBasis: Kayseri Metropolitan Municipality publishes its city guide and cadastral GIS activity page, while TKGM provides the national parcel-query service. The municipal cadastral app is described as login-accessible; an anonymous one-point request through the reviewed TKGM adapter was blocked upstream (HTTP 403). These sources establish registry/map infrastructure, not usable Kayseri vector coverage.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The public TKGM provider blocked the single anonymous WUP-point request with HTTP 403; the municipal cadastral application is login-gated. No full polygon sample is verified.
scopeLimits: Official city cadastral map and national TKGM parcel viewer are identified. The city page indicates the municipal cadastral app requires login; no login attempted. A single public TKGM point-identification request at the WUP center returned upstream HTTP 403. No polygon retained and no area query performed.
remainingUncertainty: No complete georeferenced parcel polygon with a verified safe native ID was obtained for this city. Public maps or registry workflows may provide visual layers or identity-dependent services that were not queried.
